_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear_greed ~62 on the Disbelief/Hope boundary with dead ETF flows, flat funding and weak CVD keeps the coil intact; no breaker to step rung or force direction.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary in tone, but analyst explicitly HOLDs Hope while narrative only supplies bearish macro color without a forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays roughly -5% to +10% and fear_greed holds 55-70 with funding remaining near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks below 46 or above 78, or funding and 30d momentum both surge to analog heat (funding >70 and momentum >80)
